notes.title: Update to v1.1.1 "some features and bug fixes
notes.notes:
Game update: Wednesday, October 28 (Japan time)
/----------------------------------------------- new additions------------------------------------------------/

BGM is now changed for each stage.

/------------------------------------------------ bug fixed: --------------------------------------------------/

Fixed a problem in the tutorial mode where the text of the mission was not correctly displayed.

notes.title: v1.1.0 "Some features added, bugs fixed, languages added + important notices
notes.notes:
Game update: Thursday, October 22 (Japan time)
/-------------------------------------------------- new additions---------------------------------------------/

It is now possible to pause the game by pressing the P button on the keyboard or the START button on the controller during gameplay. Also, you can now select "Continue Game", "Title", or "End Game" from the paused state.

The game can now be played in languages other than Japanese.

Additional languages "English", "Chinese [Simplified Chinese]", "French", "Russian", and "Spanish".

/--------------------------------------------------- bug fix: --------------------------------------------------/

We made it easier to play with the controls because there was some inconvenience in controlling the player with the controls.

/----------------------------------------------[b]Important notice[/b]-----------------------------------------------/

The method of saving the game data is different from this version.

Back up or move [ScoreData.dat] inside GameData folder [\steamapps\common\Shooting Type\GameData], then copy [ScoreData.dat] from v.1.1.0 update file inside GameData folder
